intent: Layered colour fields and restrained longitudinal fibre linework derived from the real door used to author the model.

reference_authority.derivation_rule: Use measured wood colours and broad field relationships; do not copy photographed damage, lighting, hardware, or weathering detail.

coordinate_contract.grain_rule: Every timber follows its own construction axis.
coordinate_contract.repeat_rule: No square texture tile and no shared fibre continuation between separate timbers.

layers.purpose: Continuous base field reconstructed from all twenty sampled colours and their measured positions on the Met reverse.
Broad charcoal, grey-taupe, pale-tan, ochre, and muted-red passages traced from the reference hierarchy.
Large low-contrast areas that prevent the material from becoming evenly busy.
A few explicitly authored longitudinal colour boundaries; no wave or ring generator.
Sparse broken dark fibre accents, separated from cracks and damage.
